Name: Music Control
Author: 1F1XDRAGO
Description:
Description:  
Music Control is a lightweight and intuitive mod that lets players manage in-game music like never before.
Instantly toggle music on or off, fine-tune volume levels, and enjoy clear visual feedback when songs change.
Whether you're seeking peaceful silence while farming or want to spotlight your favorite tracks, this mod gives you full control over your soundscape.
Key Features:  
- Hotkeys to mute/unmute music  
- Volume control via keyboard shortcuts  
- Optional song name display with customizable duration  
- Automatic music reactivation during events  
- In-game notifications for volume changes
